Title: Pricing Catalogue + Price Versioning
Summary: Provider/model-independent, effective-dated pricing catalogue. Rates are data in config/pricing/pricing-catalogue.json, consumed only through catalogue lookups. Historic prices preserved via [EffectiveFromUtc, EffectiveToUtc) versioning; only legitimate mutation is closing a predecessor at a successor's boundary. DeepSeek time-band resolver isolated in AiPricingTimeBands.ps1 (PEAK [01:00,04:00) + [06:00,10:00) UTC, boundary tests mandatory). Zero paid API calls, zero network, zero credentials.

SeedCatalogue.Note: All records Source='reference', VerifiedAtUtc=null -> NEEDS_REVIEW until verified against provider documentation. deepseek-v4-pro, gpt-5.4-nano, gpt-5.4, gemini-economical not yet in DB-M14 model catalogue -> warning (needs review), not error.

DBM17Overlap.Details: AttemptStore.ps1, Test-AttemptStore.ps1, state/attempts/ are DB-M17-owned; not created or modified by DB-M15. No DB-M17 file overlaps DB-M15-owned pricing files.

DBM12Overlap.Details: src/DevBridge.Engine, src/DevBridge.Tests, src/DevBridge.UI are DB-M12-owned; not touched by DB-M15.

LaneCOverlap.Details: Lane C concurrency/workbook artifacts (logs/dbm04_*, logs/workbook-backups, logs/selftest) untouched by DB-M15; no overlap with config/pricing/ or scripts/ai-routing/ pricing files.

NotesForDBM16: Get-AiPriceAt/Get-AiCurrentPrice return PriceLookupResult v1 (Rate fields per 1,000,000 tokens, Currency USD, ProcessingTier, TimeBand, TimestampUtc, LookupState). DB-M16 consumes matched Record rates + token counts to compute actual cost and USD->INR conversion. No cost logic in DB-M15. Historic lookup available for actual-cost reconciliation (IsExpired/IsFuture/HasGap flags signal coverage gaps).
